title: notes: add tags behind ff_tags
author: sam-lee-dev

summary: Notes can now carry up to 8 tags; the notes list shows a Tags column and a tag bar with counts.
Everything is behind the feature flag ff_tags: with it off, GET /api/tags answers 404 not_enabled and no tag UI is shown.
The editor gets a Tags field (comma separated); the admin dashboard swaps 'Words written' for 'Tags in use' when the flag is on.
extras: The developer also touched the settings API while adding the tags route (worth a role check on /api/settings).
The notes table got a new column, so check it still fits on a phone.
security: Tag input is validated on the server (lower-case words, max 8); check the editor shows the error instead of failing silently.
tips: works: do each step once with the flag on (node flags.mjs --on=ff_tags) and note what you see.
roles: use the role switcher in the ribbon; a guest must never see an edit button.
phone: switch the device to Phone 390 and scroll the page sideways - if it moves, that is a fail.
stability: reload the page after saving; your change must still be there.

focus: Tags show up in the notes list and the editor only when ff_tags is on
Settings stay admin-only (a member must get 403 from GET /api/settings)
The notes list fits a 390 px phone without sideways scrolling
Guests can read shared notes, and nothing else

pages.why: Expected: notes table, and with ff_tags on a Tags column and a tag bar
Expected: editor with a Tags field when ff_tags is on
Expected: 'Tags in use' card when ff_tags is on
Expected: settings form loads and saves
Expected: shared notes only, read-only, tags shown when on

access.name: Guest cannot open a team-only note

manual.title: Tags save and come back after a reload
manual.why: Tags that silently disappear make the feature useless
steps: Turn the flag on: node flags.mjs --on=ff_tags
Type 'onboarding, how-to, week-one' in Tags and press Save note
manual.good: The three tags are still in the Tags field after the reload, and the notes list shows them

manual.title: A bad tag shows a clear message
manual.why: Users need to know why a save did not work
steps: With the flag on, open New note
Type a title, then 'Big Ideas!' in Tags
manual.good: A short message under the buttons explains the tag rule; nothing is saved

manual.title: Guests see tags but cannot edit
manual.why: Guests are outside the company and must stay read-only
steps: Look for any edit button, editor link or settings link
manual.good: Tags show on the shared cards; there is no way to edit anything

manual.title: Notes list fits a phone
manual.why: Most of the team checks notes on their phone
steps: Try to scroll the page sideways
manual.good: The page does not move sideways; every column can be read

manual.title: Turning the flag off hides every trace of tags
manual.why: A half-hidden feature confuses people while it is being tested
steps: Turn the flag off: node flags.mjs --off=ff_tags
Reload Notes, the editor and the admin dashboard
manual.good: No Tags column, no tag bar, no Tags field; the dashboard shows 'Words written' again
